Cybersecurity · 5 min read

Cybersecurity fundamentals for small and growing businesses

Practical security habits and controls to help smaller organizations make more informed decisions.

Cybersecurity is an ongoing practice, not a product purchase. Understand which accounts, devices and business information matter most, who can access them and how the organization would respond to a disruption.

What to consider

Use individual accounts and multi-factor authentication where available. Review access when people change roles, remove access that is no longer needed and keep software updated with a documented patching routine.

Back up important data and periodically test that it can be restored. Decide how staff should report suspicious messages or unexpected account activity.

The right next steps depend on each organization. Prioritize practical improvements, assign responsibility and revisit the plan as systems change.
